_about: Search test on the public CRCOG Legislative Committee recording (benchmarks/zoom-cases). Each query has the time (seconds) where the answer is said; a hit counts if its opened line is within 60 s of it. Queries are paraphrases, not copies of the transcript, plus Swedish and French questions about the English talk, misspelt words, and 'what did X say about Y'.
